question: Should we stop CNC-02 for 8 hours this week, and will SO-45060 still ship on time?
sql: SELECT so_id, qty, qty_shipped, due_date FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_erp_sales_orders WHERE so_id='SO-45060'
SELECT po.prod_order_id, po.qty, po.qty_good FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_mes_production_orders po WHERE po.so_id='SO-45060'

SELECT prod_order_id, shift_date, SUM(qty_good) AS daily_good FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_mes_production_lots WHERE prod_order_id=(SELECT prod_order_id FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_mes_production_orders WHERE so_id='SO-45060') AND end_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY prod_order_id, shift_date ORDER BY shift_date DESC LIMIT 7
SELECT material_id, qty_on_hand FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_erp_spare_parts_stock WHERE material_id='SP-BRG-7014' ORDER BY as_of_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT material_lot_id, balance_grade_claimed FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_sqm_certificates_of_analysis WHERE material_lot_id='ML-24-0901'
SELECT inspection_id, material_lot_id, inspection_type, characteristic, result FROM js_mysql_mfg.js_mysql_mfg.cnc_sqm_incoming_inspections WHERE material_lot_id='ML-24-0901'
SELECT note_id, text FROM cnc-demo-shift-logbook WHERE note_id='LB-00217'
SELECT wo_id, status, problem FROM js_manuf_ice.cnc_cmms.work_orders WHERE asset_id='CNC-02' AND status='OPEN'
answer: Yes, stop CNC-02 for eight hours this week. SO-45060 has 296 parts remaining (1600 ordered, 1304 good parts already produced) at roughly 68-80 good parts per day, so completion is around 6 May against an 8 May due date, leaving a two-day buffer even after an extra day for the 8-hour stop. Logbook note LB-00217 shows the operator installed toolholder HSK #7 (SUP-C) on 10 Apr and skipped the runout and balance checks. Certificate COA-ML-24-0901 for that toolholder shows a balance grade of G6.3, while the material spec requires G2.5 maximum, and the receiving inspection for balance/runout was SKIPPED. Spare part SP-BRG-7014 currently shows 0 stock with reorder point 1, so order one before the stop. Open WO-24-0241 is already tracking the CNC-02 chatter issue.
